criteria.title: Requirements and design
criteria.description: Identifies requirements and justifies an appropriate design.

levels.label: 1ST (85)
levels.descriptor: Thorough, prioritised requirements; design critically justified against alternatives.

levels.label: 1ST (75)
levels.descriptor: Thorough, prioritised requirements; design critically justified against alternatives.
Clear requirements; design justified with appropriate diagrams.
Clear requirements; design justified with appropriate diagrams.
Requirements listed; design described with limited justification.

levels.label: 3RD (48)
levels.descriptor: Some requirements listed; design largely undocumented.

levels.label: 3RD (42)
levels.descriptor: Some requirements listed; design largely undocumented.

levels.label: FAIL (35)
levels.descriptor: Requirements missing or unrelated to the brief.

levels.label: FAIL (20)
levels.descriptor: Requirements missing or unrelated to the brief.

criteria.title: Implementation
criteria.description: Builds a working application that meets the requirements.

levels.label: 1ST (85)
levels.descriptor: All requirements met; robust, well-structured code with thoughtful extras.

levels.label: 1ST (75)
levels.descriptor: All requirements met; robust, well-structured code with thoughtful extras.
Most requirements met; well-structured, readable code.
Most requirements met; well-structured, readable code.
Working core features; code quality inconsistent.

levels.label: 3RD (48)
levels.descriptor: Partially working; significant requirements unmet.

levels.label: 3RD (42)
levels.descriptor: Partially working; significant requirements unmet.

levels.label: FAIL (35)
levels.descriptor: Application does not run or bears little relation to the design.

levels.label: FAIL (20)
levels.descriptor: Application does not run or bears little relation to the design.

criteria.title: Testing and evaluation
criteria.description: Tests the application and evaluates it against the requirements.

levels.label: 1ST (85)
levels.descriptor: Comprehensive testing strategy; critical evaluation with evidence.

levels.label: 1ST (75)
levels.descriptor: Comprehensive testing strategy; critical evaluation with evidence.
Systematic testing, including automated tests; evaluation against requirements.
Systematic testing, including automated tests; evaluation against requirements.
Planned testing of main features; limited evaluation.

levels.label: 3RD (48)
levels.descriptor: Ad hoc manual testing only.

levels.label: 3RD (42)
levels.descriptor: Ad hoc manual testing only.

levels.label: FAIL (35)
levels.descriptor: No meaningful testing.

levels.label: FAIL (20)
levels.descriptor: No meaningful testing.

criteria.title: Reflection and professional practice
criteria.description: Reflects on the process and relates it to professional practice.

levels.label: 1ST (85)
levels.descriptor: Critical, well-evidenced reflection with clear actions for future practice.

levels.label: 1ST (75)
levels.descriptor: Critical, well-evidenced reflection with clear actions for future practice.
Insightful reflection linked to professional practice.
Insightful reflection linked to professional practice.
Some reflection on challenges, with limited insight.

levels.label: 3RD (48)
levels.descriptor: Descriptive account of what was done.

levels.label: 3RD (42)
levels.descriptor: Descriptive account of what was done.

levels.label: FAIL (35)
levels.descriptor: No reflection.

levels.label: FAIL (20)
levels.descriptor: No reflection.
